Write code that synthesizes plain text to an audio byte stream using a concrete provider.

  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk

  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY

  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

output_text:
import os
from typing import Union, Optional

from google.cloud import texttospeech


def synthesize_text_to_audio_bytes(
    text: str,
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    voice_name: Optional[str] = None,
    speaking_rate: float = 1.0,
    pitch: float = 0.0,
    audio_encoding: str = "MP3",
) -> bytes:
    """
    Synthesize plain text to an audio byte stream using Google Cloud Text-to-Speech.

    Requires:
        - google-cloud-texttospeech
        - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS set to a service account JSON path

    Args:
        text: Plain text to synthesize.
        language_code: BCP-47 language code, e.g. "en-US".
        voice_name: Optional specific Google TTS voice name.
        speaking_rate: Speaking rate multiplier.
        pitch: Voice pitch adjustment.
        audio_encoding: One of "MP3", "LINEAR16", "OGG_OPUS", "MULAW", "ALAW".

    Returns:
        Audio bytes from the TTS response.
    """
    if not text or not text.strip():
        raise ValueError("text must be non-empty")

    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()

    synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=text)

    voice_params = {"language_code": language_code}
    if voice_name:
        voice_params["name"] = voice_name
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(**voice_params)

    encoding_map = {
        "MP3": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3,
        "LINEAR16": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        "OGG_OPUS": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.OGG_OPUS,
        "MULAW": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MULAW,
        "ALAW": texttospeech.AudioEncoding.ALAW,
    }
    try:
        encoding = encoding_map[audio_encoding.upper()]
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unsupported audio_encoding: {audio_encoding}. "
            f"Choose from {', '.join(encoding_map.keys())}."
        ) from exc

    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(
        audio_encoding=encoding,
        speaking_rate=speaking_rate,
        pitch=pitch,
    )

    response = client.synthesize_speech(
        input=synthesis_input,
        voice=voice,
        audio_config=audio_config,
    )

    return bytes(response.audio_content)
